pattern: search {p:Player} 's graveyard , hand [,] and library for any number of cards with the same name as {o:Obj} and exile them
subject: none

examples.text: Exile target artifact. Search its controller's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as that artifact and exile them. Then that player shuffles.
Destroy target enchantment. Search its owner's graveyard, hand and library for any number of cards with the same name as that enchantment and exile them. Then that player shuffles.

counterExamples: Exile target Equipment. Search its controller's graveyard, hand, and library for all cards with the same name as that Equipment and exile them. Then that player shuffles.
Exile target artifact. Search its controller's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as that artifact and put them into your hand. Then that player shuffles.
Exile target artifact. Search its controller's graveyard and library for any number of cards with the same name as that artifact and exile them. Then that player shuffles.

pattern: {p:Player} shuffles , then draws a card for each {f:Filter}
subject: none

examples.text: Exile target artifact. Search its controller's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as that artifact and exile them. That player shuffles, then draws a card for each card exiled from their hand this way.

Destroy target enchantment. Search its owner's graveyard, hand and library for any number of cards with the same name as that enchantment and exile them. That player shuffles, then draws a card for each card exiled from their hand this way.

counterExamples: Exile target artifact. Search its controller's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as that artifact and exile them. That player shuffles, then draws two cards for each card exiled from their hand this way.

Exile target artifact. Search its controller's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as that artifact and exile them. That player shuffles, then discards a card for each card exiled from their hand this way.

Exile target artifact. Search its controller's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as that artifact and exile them. You shuffle, then draw a card for each card exiled from their hand this way.
